info.title: Robot Station Console API
info.description: Implemented: real host diagnostics, passive DDS/ZMQ/XRoboToolkit readers and managed ROS 2 image bridge, no-motion deployment jobs, recording task management, named Parquet playback and offline conversion. Implemented: connection profiles/restore, bounded ROS diagnostics, named poses and independent fixed-base MuJoCo control with expiring browser leases. Real G1 HG/PR adapter implemented with local commissioning gates, supported-joint-test scope and independent watchdogs; physical calibration pending. Task-model inference and workflow execution remain reserved. Managed SONIC lifecycle now supports loopback simulation and onsite-gated real startup, original PICO start/mode controls, index-based feedback, normal protocol stop and exact process exit confirmation. Legacy stack/record POSTs are disabled. LAN commands require an operator session; browser writes require same-origin and X-Console-CSRF. Model secrets stay server-side.

schema.description: Bounded read-only ROS graph scan with publisher names, offered type/QoS and compatibility, frame counters/skew/errors, network carrier, G1/BMS age and model state. Only allowlisted fields; no environment, operation/session/lease keys, raw logs or dataset content.

200.description: Authorized sanitized ZIP of diagnostics.json and README.txt

get.summary: Read-only protocol/mapping/reference gains and local commissioning status; template query returns an UNAPPROVED generic reference JSON. No web approval/write route.
Read managed SONIC session, process/initialization/feedback and start/stop blockers
Authorized bounded current-session component logs (12KB tail)

Joint.description: Name is authoritative. Do not interpret URDF visualization order as DDS motor index.

Battery.description: Read from actual G1 BMS. Missing/invalid/stale feedback is unknown. Browser sample TTL 15 s; robot TTL 5 s.

Robot.description: For G1 body feedback supply all 29 unique names matching assets/g1/profile.json; finger joints are separate capabilities. A listening port is insufficient to mark connected.

Camera.description: observed_at is the latest decoded frame time, not a heartbeat. TTL 5 s. URLs must be same-origin proxy or reachable HTTP(S), with no credentials. video must be browser-native; no HLS/WebRTC adapter is bundled.

Adapter.description: Backend validates action semantics, named dimension/order, units, coordinates, frequency, limits and controller compatibility before can_infer=true.

Job.description: Accepted is not ready. waiting means software prepared but external devices are absent. Only ready proves all observed sources are fresh. Poll GET deployment/jobs/{job_id} for bounded logs. Preparation never starts the motion controller.

OperatorAccess.description: Workstation-local CLI/SSH connections are trusted. LAN writes need an 8-hour signed HttpOnly session obtained using the local operation-key. Browser writes additionally send X-Console-CSRF from an authorized snapshot. Never log the key.

CollectionStatus.description: The durable worker acknowledges explicit start/save/discard/end commands. Only confirmed worker state is displayed. Owns the recording task, does not initialize or take over the external SONIC motion controller. Data loss finalizes current frames as discarded when possible; incomplete output is preserved.

Snapshot.description: Only the v1 endpoint is trusted for execution capabilities. Frontend source/live flags are assigned locally. Totals.episodes counts retained real episodes only; demo_episodes is separate. Backend MUST repeat all interlocks atomically; UI checks are not a safety boundary.

Accepted.description: Accepted starts are asynchronous; inspect snapshot.sonic or GET controller. Controller stop only reports confirmed after exact process exit and owned input/simulator cleanup. motion_stop_supported=false means no hardware E-stop guarantee. Local SONIC approval is distinct from independent joint-SDK commissioning.

Workflow.description: Exactly one start/end, unique node/edge ids, no dangling edges, all nodes reachable; one outgoing edge per outcome. Bounded transitions/timeouts enforced by backend. Never execute a graph directly as code/shell.

Timeseries.description: Reads observation.state and action.wbc by declared unique names; retains full declared dimensions including hands. Rejects absent names, incompatible units, malformed frames or non-increasing timestamps. The first recorded frame is video zero. max_points bounds visualization only, preserving first/last and reporting sampled=true; original files are never changed.

payload.description: sim initialize starts fixed-base MuJoCo without requiring preexisting feedback. sim claim accepts manual owner and returns lease_token. apply_pose requires unique named 29 joints in rad, increasing sequence, private lease_token and fresh physical feedback. release requires lease_token. Real motion and set_mode are gated. connect is read-only.

connect/start require model configuration. start additionally requires nonempty task, validated adapter, all observations, controller ready, exclusive task-model ownership; recording requires backend support.

prepare/start require dataset, task, fps, camera_ids. Backend checks calibrated PICO/trackers, clocks, cameras, 29 joint feedback and exclusive ownership. save/discard terminate only the current unsaved recording. end releases PICO task ownership.

Capability name is services.{service_id}.{action}. Docker stop targets the owned immutable container id and only an idle container; pc_service stop closes the owned PC Service and Unity 3D. Both require no recording/manual/preparation/controller activity. Service metadata stop_allowed/stop_reason reports blockers. Explicit start resumes an operator-stopped XR service. controller.start prepares the owned container/XR, simulator in sim mode, C++ and calibrated PICO input; no automatic PICO start key. Real start requires confirmed_real_start and local onsite approval. Controller stop ends its recording task first and operates only on the selected session.

Backend stops current task/recording and relinquishes control via a validated controller policy. Always accept authorized stop regardless of stale revision/ownership; this is a software task stop, not a substitute for physical emergency stop.
Run only validated backend node implementations; UI-only preview_fail is stripped.

ConversionJob.description: Offline job: does not use robot capabilities. Source restricted to direct SONIC outputs datasets. Exclusive new output directory; partial cancelled/failed output retained with .incomplete. Never overwrite or delete source. One active conversion at a time. Server restarts do not stop worker.

ConversionInspection.description: Metadata/version/paths/files preflight. Worker additionally validates all Parquet values, per-episode timestamps and video frame counts. LeRobot v3 and debug CSV are not accepted.

CameraSource.description: ROS 2 image-only bridge runs in its own process/domain (default 99); Unitree DDS domain is unchanged. Uses source header timestamps, bounded skew and explicit resize. cameras service start/stop owns only this publisher; recording blocks its reconfiguration.

ConnectionConfig.description: All fields validated by SystemDriver and validate_ros2_config. ROS default Domain 99 is independent of Unitree DDS Domain 0. No real-motion enable flag is accepted.

ConfigurationWrite.description: Writes require current config_revision, reject active preparation/recording/manual owner, and create a backup before applying. validate is read-only. Save stops old readers; reconnect via robot.connect with latest snapshot revision. Profiles and backup restore never resume robot motion.

NamedPose.description: Complete unique named 29 joints; exact model limits, profile/hash and radians checked before saving. Saving/loading is not sending. Archive retains recoverable JSON.

ManualStatus.description: Actual fixed-base MuJoCo inertia/gravity/torque simulation, not balance validation. reached means max joint error <0.03 rad after transition. No simulated BMS value. Real provider unitree-sdk2-hg-pr uses validated HG feedback, local 4h/boot/host/source-bound commissioning, MotionSwitcher.CheckMode (no automatic ReleaseMode), unique LowState discovery and no foreign LowCmd writers. Starts supported-joint tests from observed posture; never auto-zero or balance. Normal release/lease expiry damps then disables for mechanically supported robots. Invalid feedback, mode/source conflicts or control deadline faults cease publishing; this is not a physical E-stop guarantee. Real worker is never boot-autostarted or auto-rearmed.

ManualRequest.description: Dedicated live target/heartbeat channel. One claim returns a private lease_token only to that caller; never included in snapshots/bundles. Heartbeat every <=1s, expires after 3s. Target sequence strictly increases per lease. Latest-wins UI sends <=10Hz, one in-flight. Backend extends minimum-jerk duration to satisfy velocity limit. Worker independently holds current position on expiry; web restart revokes ownership. Real mode requires a locally commissioned provider; without approval returns onsite_validation_required. Limits may be stricter than the simulation limits. Only heartbeat/apply_pose allowed on this channel.

CommissioningTemplate.description: Unapproved generic reference only, never a transferable motion approval.

SonicFeedback.description: Actual g1_debug uses index and control_loop_type=cpp. Requires >=3 increasing frames, finite named-order 29 measured joints and <=0.5s monotonic age. Duplicate/regressed/invalid packets do not refresh validity. ros_timestamp can legitimately be zero. robot_config proves configuration heartbeat only.

SonicStatus.description: Single owned session across both modes; no controller autostart. Simulation is fixed to lo/DDS0. Real startup additionally needs current local SONIC-specific onsite approval and confirmed_real_start=true; it initializes standing/hands. PICO manager starts only after fresh calibrated tracking. Proxy owns loopback input; sends protocol stop, verifies immutable-container process identity/exit, then stops manager/simulator. No real SIGKILL or PID/name-based broad stop. PID+start tick+session+argv ownership is required. Unconfirmed exit stays fault and blocks restart. Web/parent loss requests stop, never re-arms.

x-integration-order: single owner + software stop + G1 controller initialization
